items.title: Musk, Nvidia workers call for Huang return at Nvidia in petition
items.summary: An online petition to bring back Jensen Huang, who resigned last week as CEO, has drawn more than 170,000 signatures, including almost 9,000 current Nvidia employees.

items.title: Should Nvidia stock be a buy ahead of earnings?
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) stock has been under pressure since the Jensen Huang affair hit the news. With the AI chip giant's next earnings report out Nov. 17, is the recent pullback a buying opportunity? Barron's associate editor Al Root joins "The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman and Pras Subramanian to break it down.

items.title: A high-stakes week for tech: Anthropic IPO and Nvidia earnings
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi previews a huge week for the tech market, with Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) set to file for its IPO and Nvidia (NVDA) set to deliver its earnings call as investors brace for results. items.title: Super Micro Falls 5% as Reported DOJ Smuggling Probe Weighs for a Third Session; Dell and Hewlett Packard Enterprise Drop 4%

items.title: Tech shares slide ahead of Nvidia earnings, Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Technology stocks struggled to recover Monday from the crisis engulfing Nvidia after its chief Jensen Huang quit, with the latest earnings from the AI chip giant as well as Anthropic's huge market debut arguing for caution.He quit following revelations of extramarital affairs, including with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy trying to get banned Nvidia chips into China, and another with an Nvidia executive who reported directly to him.

Huang resigned a day earlier, after reports of extramarital affairs. By Monday, the “Stand with Jensen” letter had more than 160,000 signatures. ...
